notes.title: TREE is in the Top 100 of Best Steam Games of 2018 according to user reviews
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152816/da2c5726577c2f1a33bc6f27c264bcfa0531f644.jpg[/img]

Hello every one,

Recently, we found out that our game has made it to the [url=https://steam250.com/2018] Top 100 of Best Games of 2018 on Steam based on user ratings[/url]. All we can say is "Wow" and "Thank you"!

When we've made this little project, we never thought in our craziest dreams that we would have such huge support for it. We're happy that our game resonates with you all, and that you enjoyed this small experience that we've made. 

Thank you so much for your support. And may 2019 be the year were something trully wonderful happens. 


Regards, 

The Strangers

notes.title: TREE's soundtrack is now on Spotify
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Another quick word from us. 

Our game's soundtrack is now available for free on Spotify. So, if you want to listen to our music on the go, in the office, while you're doing work, or just relaxing, you can now do so in the link below. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152816/cd5270ecf9eca52e1ddfd9c29042b58bb239c423.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6OTir3xKtJOti7nQ8OgSqH?si=xLF9yfoBQlmN-92VNyymhw] TREE by Pawel Blaszczak [/url][/h1]

Once again, thank you for all your support. And please, leave a comment/feedback/anything at all - we love reading your thoughts. 

It's been a beautiful story so far - thanks for being a part of it. 


Until (maybe) next time, 

Taj

notes.title: TREE now supports ultra-widescreens
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152816/90ef17d77a329d9f4dddda333cf0e278e967de61.jpg[/img]

Just what the headline says - you can now play TREE in ultra-widescreen glory. 

And once again, thanks so much for all your reviews and positive comments. We are now getting closer to our 200th review, so please, leave one if you feel the need to say a few words. 


Until (perhaps) next time

Taj

notes.title: Thank you for your comments, love, and feedback
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33152816/e5dcdb36ae2fd1e8ac4cfe989768052777aab187.jpg[/img]

We are trully blown away by the amount of positive feedback that our little game is getting from you all. For that, we just want to say a huge "Thank You" from all of us. 

Please, if have some thoughts that you would like to share on our game, leave a review. We love reading them all and they help us out tremendously. 

And remember - keep in touch with the ones you care about. 


Regards,

Taj
